events.verdict: Mudiay (NYK) makes contact with the ball during Wall's (WAS) driving shot attempt.
Porter Jr. (WAS) makes contact with Mudiay's (NYK) arm during his shooting motion on his jump shot.
Mudiay (NYK) and Oubre Jr. (WAS) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Oubre Jr. (WAS) sets the screen on Vonleh (NYK) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Morris (WAS) sets the screen in Dotson's (NYK) path and gives him room to avoid contact.
Dotson (NYK) maintains a legal guarding position during Wall's (WAS) drive and the players make incidental foot to foot contact.
Morris (WAS) makes contact with Mudiay's (NYK) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
Morris (WAS) maintains verticality during Vonleh's (NYK) shot attempt.
Morris (WAS) sets the screen on Mudiay (NYK) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Mudiay (NYK) cleanly deflects the loose ball away from Morris (WAS).
From the available angles, Wall (WAS) tips the ball away from Lee (NYK) on the baseline.
[Observable in enhanced video] Wall (WAS) tips the ball away from Lee (NYK) and it hits the baseline out of bounds.
Wall (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Lee (NYK). Contact is initiated by Lee moving back into Wall.
